about: AirIQ Inc. provides fleet management, productivity, and IoT solutions in North America. The company offers video telematics system, GPS tracking system, asset tracking system, driver coaching, and tracking reports; field service management solutions; and smart battery powered solutions. It also provides trailer tracking products, such as AssetTrac, StealthNet, and SolarNET, as well as remote update, cargo, brake, tire, and light circuit sensors; video telematics solutions; and IQ LED solutions. In addition, the company offers IQ-BATT, a battery power solution; video telematic solution, including IQ-CAM, IQ-CAM MC30, and IQ-CAM ME40; wired solutions, such as IQ-PLUG-87, IQ-WIRED-68, and IQ-Wired-28; IQ-PLUG-87, a Plug and Play Solution; Tool Tag, a tool tracking solutions; and cargo management, driver assist, location management, and tire management solutions. It offers its products through online or via a mobile app, and include vehicle locating, boundary notification, automated inventory reports, maintenance reminders, security alerts, and vehicle disabling and unauthorized movement alerts. The company serves tool tracking solutions, health care, food and beverage, trades and service, rental, and trucking and transportation industries. AirIQ Inc. was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Pickering, Canada.
